PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp Reports Steady Revenue Growth Amid Strong Regional Demand

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp, a prominent provider of oilfield services and equipment in the United Arab Emirates, posted robust financial results for the first quarter of 2024, buoyed by stable oil prices and ongoing infrastructure projects across the Gulf region.

The company reported revenues of AED 1.14 billion, marking a 7% increase from the same period last year. Net profit reached AED 142 million, up 5% year-on-year, in line with market expectations. Company executives attributed the strong performance to a diversified service portfolio and continued investment in offshore support operations.

“The market environment in the UAE and wider Middle East remains favorable, with consistent project activity from both national and international operators,” said Nguyen Hoang Nam, Chief Executive Officer of PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp, during a conference call with analysts. “Our integrated service offerings and commitment to operational excellence have positioned us well to capture new contracts and deliver sustainable value to our stakeholders.”

The company’s drilling support and engineering services segments led the growth, benefitting from recent contract wins tied to the expansion of offshore oilfields in Abu Dhabi and Ras Al Khaimah. Analysts noted that the UAE’s push to boost oil production capacity and invest in energy infrastructure bodes well for service providers like PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp.

“PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp continues to demonstrate resilience in a competitive market, supported by a healthy backlog and strong client relationships,” said Kareem Al Nuaimi, an energy analyst at Gulf Investment Research. “Their disciplined approach to cost management has also contributed to margin stability, even as input costs fluctuate.”

The company reported a backlog of AED 3.2 billion as of March 31, 2024, reflecting a healthy pipeline of projects scheduled for execution over the next 18 months. Capital expenditures for the quarter stood at AED 95 million, mainly allocated to upgrading offshore service vessels and expanding digital monitoring capabilities.

Looking ahead, management reaffirmed its guidance for moderate revenue growth in 2024, citing continued demand for technical services and equipment across the UAE’s upstream sector. The company plans to focus on operational efficiency, workforce development, and technological innovation to maintain its competitive edge.

PetroVietnam Technical Services Corp shares closed up 1.6% on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange following the earnings announcement.
